module_title: Economic Survey - Sectoral Growth, Banking & Infrastructure
introduction: This level focuses on the performance of different sectors of the economy (Agriculture, Industry, Services), the health of the banking system, and the impact of massive capital expenditure on infrastructure development.

core_concepts.title: Robust Health of the Banking Sector
core_concepts.description: Asset quality of Scheduled Commercial Banks (SCBs) is at a multi-decade best. The Gross Non-Performing Assets (GNPA) have dropped to 2.2%, and Net NPA (NNPA) stands at just 0.5%.

core_concepts.title: Services and Industry Sectors
core_concepts.description: The Services sector remains the primary engine of growth (estimated at 9.1%). The Industrial sector also posted a strong Gross Value Added (GVA) growth of 7.0% in the first half of the year.

core_concepts.title: Infrastructure Push
core_concepts.description: The National Highway network has expanded by 60% since 2014, reaching 146,572 km. Railway electrification is nearly 100% complete.

core_concepts.title: Capital Expenditure (Capex)
core_concepts.description: The Central Government's effective capital expenditure has risen from a pre-pandemic average of 2.7% to approximately 4% of GDP, driving asset creation and employment.

core_concepts.title: Renewable Energy Transition
core_concepts.description: India has added 38.61 GW of new renewable energy capacity. India now ranks 3rd globally in both overall renewable energy capacity and installed solar capacity.

important_entities.name: GNPA (Gross Non-Performing Assets)
important_entities.significance: Indicates that the banking system has successfully cleaned up its balance sheets and 'bad loans' have significantly reduced.

important_entities.name: Aviation Market
important_entities.significance: India is now the third-largest domestic aviation market, with the number of airports increasing from 74 in 2014 to 164 currently.

important_entities.name: GST Collection
important_entities.significance: Registered a YoY growth of 6.7%. The survey also proposed simplifying the GST structure to a 'two-rate' system.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: While services and industry are growing rapidly (7%+), agriculture growth is usually much lower (around 3-4%) due to climate change and unseasonal rains. Do not assume equal growth across all sectors.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Third in the Air, Third in the Sun
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: India ranks 3rd globally in the Aviation market (Air) and 3rd in installed Solar/Renewable capacity (Sun).

exam_strategy_tips: Banking aspirants must memorize the GNPA (2.2%) and NNPA (0.5%) figures.
UPSC aspirants should focus on statement-based questions regarding infrastructure (e.g., Highway expansion percentages and Railway electrification).
